reason_for_change: The first archived native-agent overlap round left writer B with zero items after a global revision conflict. A separate runner audit reproduced a direct writer changing the target between the runner precheck and the engine read. Independent review then reproduced a manifest prepared against external p1 version 1 binding its content to p1 version 2 when no reference version was declared.

contract.direct_put: Callers can supply expected_version (0 for create) and expected_deps for every direct ref. Complete guards enable at most three internal retries after unrelated global sequence changes; target, direct ref, or case identity changes raise ConflictError. Legacy or partial guards remain fail-fast.
contract.runner: All manifests for a case remain serialized. A put step with an external ref requires an exact expected_deps map before any ledger write; refs created earlier in the same manifest inherit the earlier step's declared result version. The runner passes target and ref expectations to the engine, including across direct-writer races.
contract.external_anchor: Anchor verification errors are not retried; the external custodian still must advance the exact head after each authorized event.

limits: The collision test uses two real local processes, not two model agents; it checks correctness, not throughput or quality improvement.
Expected dependencies cover direct refs. Content depending on other case state needs explicit coordination and review.
A direct put without complete expectations remains fail-fast and does not prove the author's earlier read snapshot.
The smoke cases and signatures are synthetic. No normative human approval, reserved model comparison, field intervention, or measured impact is shown.
The wheel is a local build artifact and is not committed.
